purpose: Teach: アトム/ウィルソン/ロジャー/琢磨/綾子/ユーゴ/金具/悪しき

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが鉄腕アトムの映画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's in there watching the Astro Boy movie.
lines.style: Warm, brisk report over her shoulder; a small amused lift on the movie title.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとウィルソン・ピケットのファンクCD聴いたよ
lines.en: Mama, Dad and I listened to a Wilson Pickett funk CD!
lines.style: Soft eager burst; stumbling slightly over the singer's name, beaming through the last word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがロジャー・ウォーターズの音楽を流してらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's got Roger Waters playing again.
lines.style: Relaxed, wry delivery; a fond, faintly exasperated head-shake audible in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとF1の佐藤琢磨選手のレース観たよ
lines.en: Mama, I watched Takuma Sato's F1 race with Dad!
lines.style: Fast, breathy child excitement; a loud little spike on the race, barely pausing for air.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「綾子おばさんは料理上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying, "Aunt Ayako is a wonderful cook."
lines.style: Conversational and warm; the quote delivered with a knowing, appreciative smile.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと旧ユーゴ系の音楽聴いたよ
lines.en: Mama, Dad and I listened to some music from the old Yugoslavia!
lines.style: Curious, slower delivery; testing the unfamiliar country name carefully, then brightening at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが家具の金具を新しく取り付けて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad put brand-new metal fittings on the furniture for us.
lines.style: Pleased, matter-of-fact warmth; gentle emphasis on the new fittings, gratitude underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「悪しき友達から離れなさい」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mama, Dad taught me, "Stay away from bad friends."
lines.style: Small solemn voice; repeating dad's words slowly, like reciting something very important.
